### Prepare to Teach
Author: Robert Rothwell
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/prepare-to-teach
Passage: Ezra 7:10
Points:
- Ezra serves as an enduring model for anyone called to teach God's Word.
- Faithful teaching begins with diligent, in-depth study rather than superficial knowledge.
- Teachers must prioritize obeying Scripture in daily life before instructing others.
- Living out God's truth and humbly modeling repentance makes instruction authentic and effective.

### Devotional: Ezra 7
Author: D. A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/genesis-7-matthew-7-ezra-7-acts-7/
Passage: Ezra 7:10
Points:
- Ezra exemplifies the duties and calling of those who teach God's Word to His people.
- Effective teaching requires extensive, persistent study of the Scriptures.
- Biblical study must be paired with genuine personal obedience rather than intellectual detachment.
- Believers are called to be pastor-scholars who faithfully transmit what they study and practice.
